title_en: Enforcement Case against Li Hong for Illegal Occupation of Land
keywords_en: Administrative; illegal occupation of land; first instance; Basic People's Court; Yunnan Province; natural person; Land Administration Law; Civil Procedure Law (for Trial Implementation); enforcement of administrative penalty; support for the plaintiff; illegal occupation of farmland; illegal construction of houses; administrative penalty; enforcement
full_text_en:
Enforcement Case against Li Hong for Illegal Occupation of Land

Applicant for Enforcement: Xishan District Urban and Rural Construction and Environmental Protection Bureau, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

Person Subject to Enforcement: Li Hong, male, a farmer from Dahe Village, Longtan Township, Tuanjie Subdistrict, Xishan District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

In December 1986, Li Hong, without authorization, constructed a private house on a 0.19 mu (approx. 126.7 m²) rice seedling field that he had contracted from the production team. After construction began, villagers and village cadres advised and stopped him, but Li Hong ignored them. The township government ordered Li Hong to demolish the illegal construction within three days. Li Hong said rudely: "I will continue to build the house. You have three days to arrest me!" The leaders of the subdistrict office educated Li Hong, but he was aggressive, refused to heed the advice, and forcibly completed a foundation project covering 72.39 square meters. The subdistrict office reported the matter to the district Urban and Rural Construction and Environmental Protection Bureau for handling. The bureau’s leaders personally went to Dahe Village to educate Li Hong on the Land Management Law and persuaded him to voluntarily demolish the illegal construction. Li Hong not only refused, but also said unreasonably: "Even if you send me to re-education through labor, I will still build!"

Pursuant to Article 45 of the Land Management Law of the People's Republic of China, which provides: "If a rural resident occupies land to build a house without approval or by obtaining approval through fraudulent means, the construction shall be demolished within a prescribed time limit, or the newly built house on the illegally occupied land shall be confiscated," the Xishan District Urban and Rural Construction and Environmental Protection Bureau made a decision on January 10, 1987: "Li Hong’s unauthorized construction of a house on the contracted rice seedling field is illegal. Construction must cease immediately, and the illegal construction must be demolished within three days after receipt of this decision, and the farmland shall be restored." Meanwhile, pursuant to Article 52 of the Land Management Law, the party concerned was informed that: "If a party disagrees with the administrative penalty decision, it may file a lawsuit with the people's court within 30 days of receiving the notice of the penalty decision; if no lawsuit is filed within the time limit and the decision is not complied with, the organ that made the penalty decision shall apply to the people's court for compulsory enforcement."

After the time limit set by the penalty decision of the Xishan District Urban and Rural Construction and Environmental Protection Bureau expired, Li Hong neither filed a lawsuit with the people's court nor complied with the penalty decision. In order to strictly enforce the Land Management Law, and pursuant to Article 52 of the Land Management Law, the Xishan District Urban and Rural Construction and Environmental Protection Bureau applied to the Xishan District People's Court of Kunming City, Yunnan Province, for compulsory enforcement on February 3, 1987.

The Xishan District People's Court examined the application of the Xishan District Urban and Rural Construction and Environmental Protection Bureau and found that the bureau's penalty decision against Li Hong, the person subject to enforcement, was correct. Pursuant to Article 177(1) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China (for Trial Implementation), on February 27, 1987, the court president issued a public notice, ordering Li Hong to demolish the illegal construction on the rice seedling field and restore the farmland within three days from the date of publication of the notice; if Li Hong failed to voluntarily demolish the illegal construction and restore the farmland within the time limit, the people's court would enforce demolition, and the enforcement costs would be borne by Li Hong.

After the public notice period expired, the person subject to enforcement, Li Hong, showed no sign of repentance. On March 2, the Xishan District People's Court, pursuant to Article 177(2) of the Civil Procedure Law (for Trial Implementation), invited personnel from the Tuanjie Subdistrict Office, the local police station, and other grassroots organizations to participate and assist the enforcement officers in carrying out the compulsory enforcement. Before enforcement, the enforcement officers again conducted legal education for Li Hong. Overawed by the majesty of the law, Li Hong agreed to voluntarily demolish the illegal construction. That afternoon, Li Hong completely demolished the already-constructed house foundation.
